lea.text: When Phyrexian black mana corrupts Serra's Realm and drives Serra away, Urza steps in to evacuate some of the angels to Dominaria.

atq.text: Urza's story begins in school, where he and his brother Mishra explore the sacred cave of Koilos with their master Tocasia, and Urza, falling behind in the Hall of Tagsin, discovers the Mightstone. In the caves the brothers find a stone that splits into the Mightstone and Weakstone when disturbed, and the stones reopen the way for Phyrexia's evil to reach Dominaria.

Each brother craves both halves, so they begin to mistrust one another, and their contest ends in an explosion that kills Tocasia and many others before they go separate ways. Later, at the Korlis conference, the king of Kroog attacks Mishra's forces and open conflict erupts, though Urza's Mightstone beats Mishra, who flees cursing Urza and his house.

The Brothers' War then spreads and costs Urza dearly, as Kroog is destroyed while most of its defenders are at his side, and he vows that his allies will never again need to fear for their defense. He promotes Tawnos, whose clay warriors impress him, directly to master.
At last, at Argoth, Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it, and the Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth itself.

usg.text: Urza spends much of this story trying to keep the Phyrexians from reaching Dominaria. He builds the Tolarian Academy with Barrin, creates the silver golem Karn as a probe able to survive travel through time, and gives him Xantcha's heart so that he can feel.

When Kerrick attacks Tolaria, Karn is sent back in time to stop him, and the temporal surge destroys the academy; Urza planeswalks fourteen people to safety. Years later he returns with Barrin, only to be captured and tortured by K'rrik until Karn rescues him.

In Yavimaya, Multani remembers the devastation of Argoth and ensorcells Urza in a tree for three years. When Barrin's beacon wakes him, Multani sees Urza protecting life, and together they kill K'rrik and destroy the Negators.

Urza then visits Serra's Realm, where Radiant refuses to let him take refugees and declares him a Phyrexian. He completes the skyship and christens it the Weatherlight, and in the end Radiant rips out his powerstone eyes before an explosion destroys her and reconstitutes him.

ulg.text: Urza goes to Yavimaya for allies and is taken captive by Multani, who traps him in a magnigoth tree and makes him feel the land's pain. Barrin saves him, but Multani becomes trapped within him, and the two become allies against Phyrexia.

Urza's work grows more troubling: he creates the Legacy and the Bloodline Project, manipulating marriages among families strongest in white mana, and builds the Metathran army, which Barrin contests and some researchers quit over. Barrin warns him of the toll his alliances will exact.
With Jhoira and Karn's help, he also surveys the Thran Mana Rig in Shiv and uncovers its primary purpose. In Serra's Realm Radiant tells him the harder he pushes, the stronger her people become.

uds.text: Urza prepares for the coming invasion by building an army of sorcery and power. With the Weatherlight completed, he begins a eugenics program, the Bloodline Project, to create a perfect crew and soldiers against the Phyrexians, and appoints Rayne chancellor to push her and Barrin into producing an offspring.

His metathran children are produced by an integrated system of machines, and as the invasion draws closer his means begin to resemble Phyrexia's end. Barrin doubts Urza's sanity, and Rayne urges him to start thinking like a father.

inv.text: As the Phyrexian Invasion begins and hordes pour into Dominaria, the world looks to Urza for defense. He convinces many Dominarians to set aside their differences and gathers heroes, renegades, common folk and artifacts to fight.
The price is high: Barrin, furious that Urza hid Hanna's death, exhumes her body and razes Tolaria. Teferi phases out Zhalfir and Shiv over Urza's objections.

Urza then leads the Nine Titans against Phyrexia, where Tevesh Szat betrays and kills Daria and Urza kills him. But Urza is won over by Phyrexia, kills Taysir and defects to Yawgmoth, who strips him of his powers and makes him fight Gerrard, who beheads him.
In the end Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy Weapon, which destroys Yawgmoth and ends the invasion, and Karn becomes the first artificial planeswalker.

pls.text: As portions of Rath begin appearing in Dominaria and bring Phyrexian reinforcements, Urza and Dominaria's armies lose ground. Urza sends his nine planeswalkers to attack Phyrexia with soul bombs, but Tevesh Szat betrays them, killing Kristina and Daria.

Urza says he counted on Szat's betrayal. Deep in Yawgmoth's realm he is grasped by its beauty, and when Yawgmoth shows him his tortured brother Mishra, Urza leaves him and prostrates himself before Yawgmoth.

apc.text: Urza leads the planeswalkers to Phyrexia, where Tevash Szat betrays and kills his fellow planeswalkers until Urza defeats him and uses his life force for soul bombs. Fascinated by Phyrexia's artificial nature, he then dismantles the master soul bomb and surrenders to Yawgmoth.
Yawgmoth sets Gerrard and Urza to fight in an arena, and Gerrard wins by beheading Urza, then escapes Phyrexia carrying Urza's severed head, which speaks to him.

When Yawgmoth enters Dominaria as a Black Cloud of Death, Urza reveals the final secret of the Legacy Weapon, and he has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest. Urza and Gerrard die as the Weapon activates, destroying Yawgmoth, and Karn takes up Urza's staff and becomes a planeswalker.

tsb.text: Urza appears on this set's cards as an artificer who says a perfect machine can be built from imperfect parts and who advised Teferi on isolation.

mh2.text: On this set's cards Urza is the artificer whose means began to resemble Phyrexia's end as the invasion drew closer.

bro.text: Urza and his brother Mishra grow up together, and in the caves of Koilos they find a large powerstone with Tocasia; as the stone is split, the last shred of the brothers' bond breaks. They accidentally open the portal to Phyrexia and flee the su-chi attackers.

Urza marries Kayla bin-Kroog, princess of Yotia, and later is appointed Lord Protector of the Combined Kingdoms. When the brothers discover Argoth, the war becomes a race to plunder it, and Urza turns down Titania's offer of peace.

In the last battle on Argoth, Ashnod hands the Sylex to Tawnos, who gives it to Urza, and Mishra is revealed as altered by Phyrexian constructs. Urza activates the Sylex, obliterating Argoth and becoming a planeswalker as the stones merge into his eyes.

Teferi, watching from a sojourn in the past, meets the burned Urza in a void and tells him about his future as the Planeswalker and about the Phyrexians. Urza explains that the trigger of the sylex was a person, and the void then breaks.

j25.text: Urza refuses Titania's offer of peace, and Mishra makes her people pay for the insult.
